objects.description: [DarkVishnya](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0105) has obtained and used tools such as [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357), [Winexe](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0191), and [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029).(Citation: Securelist DarkVishnya Dec 2018)
